scope: Runtime/ATB PA workspace cache and graph-owned update path

exact_issue.title: [Performance]: _npu_paged_attention_get_workspace called once per layer in every graph-param update

exact_pr.title: [Performance] Reuse PA workspace across layers in graph param update

equivalence_basis: hoist workspace query out of the per-layer loop
reuse only within one graph-param update pass
avoid cross-step reuse because seq_lens values grow
pa_workspace_cache.local_result: The 0.22.1rc1 backport reproduced the effect on Ascend 910B2: +19.77% output tok/s for 5x128 and +18.57% for 4x256 concurrency=2, with text and usage equality.

current_main_implementation.evidence: UpdatableGraph.update builds ws_buffer and reuses PA workspaces by _get_ws_key before applying graph tasks.

decision: Do not present PA workspace cache or graph-owned UpdatableGraph as a new community-absent optimization. Keep the local patch as version-backport evidence and search for a different unresolved Runtime/ATB issue before proposing an upstream change.
